create_melspectrum_feature: create a MelSpectrum feature to compute mel-frequency spectrograms from audio sound events
create_pitch_feature: create a Pitch feature to extract fundamental frequency from audio waveforms using YIN
create_wav2vec_transformer_feature: create a Wav2VecTransformer feature to extract transformer layer embeddings from audio events
create_wav2vec_convolution_feature: create a Wav2VecConvolution feature to extract convolutional layer features from audio events
extract_wav_part: extract a chunk of a WAV file between onset and offset timestamps in seconds
